standard_prerequisites.name: A point of a fibre whose residue field extension over the base is finite is a closed point of that fibre, cited from the same chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives one direction of the equivalence directly.

standard_prerequisites.name: The same-chapter characterization of locally finite type morphisms on affine charts, so that the corresponding ring map is of finite type
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the fibre ring a finite type algebra over the residue field of the image point, which is what the Nullstellensatz needs.

standard_prerequisites.name: Hilbert's Nullstellensatz in the form that a maximal ideal of a finite type algebra over a field has finite residue field extension, cited from the algebra chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the maximality of the prime of the fibre ring into finiteness of the residue field extension.

core_obligations: One direction: if the residue field extension is finite then the point is closed in its fibre by the same-chapter criterion (proof lines 3823-3825).

Set up the affine chart: assume the point is closed in its fibre and choose affine opens U inside X and V inside S with the image of U in V, so that by the same-chapter characterization the corresponding ring map is of finite type; let the primes correspond to the two points and form the fibre ring, which is a finite type algebra over the residue field of the image point (proof lines 3825-3838).

Conclude by the Nullstellensatz: closedness of the point in its fibre says that the prime of the fibre ring is maximal, so by the cited Nullstellensatz its residue field is a finite extension of the residue field of the image, and since the residue fields of the point and of that prime agree, the residue field extension of the statement is finite (proof lines 3838-3847).
proof_roadmap: The forward direction is the cited criterion (proof lines 3823-3825).

For the converse pass to an affine chart, form the fibre ring as a finite type algebra over the residue field of the image, and apply the Nullstellensatz to the maximal prime corresponding to the point (proof lines 3825-3847).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes closedness of a point in its fibre for a locally finite type morphism by finiteness of the residue field extension (statement lines 3813-3821). The counted proof is short and complete: one direction is the cited criterion, and for the converse it chooses affine charts so that the relevant ring map is of finite type, forms the fibre ring, notes that closedness of the point translates into maximality of a prime of that ring, and applies the Nullstellensatz to get the finite residue field extension (proof lines 3823-3847). It is H2: the argument is carried out in the counted span and its only inputs are the affine characterization and the Nullstellensatz.
